jobs.prompt:
Delta review of release train 4 (merge gate). Round 1 failed with ONE blocker at tools/merge-guard.mjs:18: the gate read verdicts from free text, so lines like 'PASS for oldsha; head pending' or 'head fails review (lint passed)' counted as a pass. The fix is in coordination/review/train4-delta.diff (against the round-1 head 98dd46da); the current files are in context.

New contract: for a release PR (title starts with a semver), the ONLY verdict the gate accepts is a fenced ```json block inside the `## Reviews` section with exactly verdict "pass" and head equal to the FULL 40-character headRefOid. Non-release titles are exempt. Details: headRefOid must be exactly 40 hex; malformed JSON blocks in Reviews refuse (fail closed); blocks naming another SHA are ignored history and never pass; among blocks naming the current head the last decides (pass merges, fail/anything else refuses); free prose is never a verdict; the gate runs before any `gh pr merge` call.

Pass bar (owner): confirm the round-1 blocker is CLOSED for each exploit (prose PASS for an old sha with the head mentioned as pending; prose 'head fails review (lint passed)'; a JSON pass naming a different or truncated SHA; a JSON block outside Reviews; malformed JSON; a later fail for the head). Find NEW blockers introduced by this delta: a way a release PR can pass without a valid JSON pass block for the full current head; a normal (non-release) PR being refused; a crash on a malformed/absent body or head; or the gate running after the merge. Everything else is a follow-up.

Write ONLY coordination/review/train4-delta-review.json: {"verdict":"pass"|"fail","score":0-10,"round1":[{"blocker":1,"status":"closed"|"open","evidence":""}],"blockers":[{"file":"","line":0,"problem":"","exploit_or_failure":"","fix":""}],"followups":[same shape],"summary":""}. verdict is fail if the round-1 blocker is open or blockers is non-empty.
